en: The image is a sepia-toned postcard depicting a lively street scene with people walking and market stalls along a broad avenue. The buildings lining the street are of European architectural style, with a notable church or tower on the right side. The text at the bottom is in Hungarian, reading 'Kolozsvár. Deák Ferencz-utca.' indicating a specific street in the city. Additional signage in Hungarian is visible on the left-side buildings.
